title: Edge-of-Chaos
description: Falsifiable research programme and digital-twin metrology platform (Python + Rust) testing the necessary physical conditions for primary interoceptive sentience in continuous neuromorphic substrates.
notes: v0.4.0 calibrates the state-dependence demarcation condition against a linear surrogate null (with the papers' fixed threshold alone, estimation noise passed a linear system in every run at 1000 samples), dithers quantized data before the k-NN information estimates, adds Rust unit tests and a Python/Rust parity test on identical inputs, makes unsupported real-instrument paths fail explicitly and verifies compliance limits, and fixes docker-compose and the standalone executable. See CHANGELOG.md for details and known open issues.
